name: cardgame-template
description: vanilla.js 기반 모바일 세로형 카드 대전 게임 템플릿

scripts.install:platforms: npm install --prefix platforms/playstore && npm install --prefix platforms/appstore
scripts.build: node libs/vanilla.js/tools/project.cjs build --script src/main.js --input . --output build/web --template webtemplate && node tools/cachebust.cjs
scripts.stage:playstore: node tools/manifest.cjs playstore platforms/playstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run stage --prefix platforms/playstore
scripts.sync:playstore: node tools/manifest.cjs playstore platforms/playstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run sync --prefix platforms/playstore
scripts.open:playstore: node tools/manifest.cjs playstore platforms/playstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run open --prefix platforms/playstore
scripts.build:aab:playstore: node tools/manifest.cjs playstore platforms/playstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run build:aab --prefix platforms/playstore
scripts.build:apk:playstore: node tools/manifest.cjs playstore platforms/playstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run build:apk --prefix platforms/playstore
scripts.stage:appstore: node tools/manifest.cjs appstore platforms/appstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run stage --prefix platforms/appstore
scripts.sync:appstore: node tools/manifest.cjs appstore platforms/appstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run sync --prefix platforms/appstore
scripts.open:appstore: node tools/manifest.cjs appstore platforms/appstore/capacitor.config.json -- npm run open --prefix platforms/appstore

author: ddukbaek2
